head: 134705b1474ddcfac234a0a01313874f7c8b59bc

source.ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/17425; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 912, 913, 914, 917, 918, 919 (forbid seeds 1924, 1925, 1926); hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A; the pull request's later commit 7830858fa1 wrapped the token-count mapping in str() before the merge (da4e7687b5)

rationale: The change lets info_once and warning_once take format arguments, which the lru_cache-wrapped helpers make part of the cache key, and the multimodal profiler passes a dict as one of them. row-919 (a person's comment) is required: true at head, reached from the V0 profile run, in the change, and fixed by the author's next commits (author-fix). Dropped, all model-written: row-912 (caching on the arguments drops repeats exactly as the pre-formatted f-strings did), row-913 (a bare lru_cache is bounded at 128 entries, and the cache predates the change), row-914 (warning_once accepts positional arguments since this change), row-917 and row-918 (style, and %d would be wrong for a mapping). Forbid: logger.py's info helper, where three model comments (rows 912, 913 and seed 1925, which calls Logger unhashable) are false; weight_utils.py's first warning, from row-914. Seeds 1924 (style on a correct call) and 1926 (on the real defect's line) are not forbid ranges.

expect.concern: _get_mm_num_tokens returns a dict, and warning_once now forwards its arguments into an lru_cache-wrapped helper, so when a V0 profiling run hits this warning the call raises TypeError (unhashable dict) instead of logging, and engine startup fails.

forbid.reason: Logger objects hash by identity, a bare lru_cache holds at most 128 entries, and keying on the format arguments drops repeats exactly as the old pre-formatted strings did; no info_once caller passes an unhashable argument.
warning_once takes positional format arguments since this change, and both arguments here are strings, so the call neither raises nor mis-formats.
